entry_points.text: Early init sets buckets, defaults global to armed, inits optimization and arch support, subscribes notifications and exposes sysctl; late hook optimizes. Debugfs creates directory with three files. Exception entry runs earliest.

exports.text: Single and batch breakpoint registration plus entry test. Single sanitizes flags, inserts into hash with best-effort arm and optimize. Batch rejects non-positive counts and rolls back prefix. Entry test succeeds only on arch confirmation.

Single and batch breakpoint removal uses two phases around grace. Top detaches logically under central mutex and nulls failures; bottom does arch cleanup or aggregate release only for survivors. Single equals batch of one.

Static-call reservation query reports interval collision with built-in and module patch sites. Module scan holds reference, warns on cross-module end and respects coming state for init sites. No-module build always reports free.

Supported return probing enforces entry, blacklist and size limits, defaults capacity, allocates storage then registers entry with rollback; teardown detaches under lock, waits grace, then cleanup and teardown. Disabled builds report not-supported or no-op. Flush drains task chain; find skips trampolines and warns on null cursor.

Toggle, diagnostic, blacklist and reclaim controls. Disable and enable handle gone and conditional arm; dump logs identity; ksym and area extend blacklist; weak arch populate, fixup and notify default to success or no-op; init scan retires freed-range probes; module hook excludes regions from leak scan.

hazards.text: Fatal when trampoline finds no return. Warnings cover duplicates, cross-module intervals and frame mismatch, once-only where repeated. Global ops may partially fail. Listings hide addresses without permission. Freed probes retired without restore; blacklist reclaimed after grace. Module holds released on exit; grace precedes cleanup; failed detaches nulled. Decompression aborts with error on bad headers, init, allocation, stream or window faults.

ABI uses gzip 1F 8B 08, xz FD 37 7A 58 5A 00, zstd 28 B5 2F FD with window reject. Live lines use r or k plus gone, disabled, optimized and trace tags. Notifier uses max priority and done code. Failures use invalid-arg, missing, oversize and not-supported.

invariants.text: Resolution needs one of address or symbol; symbolic path looks up, displaces, rebases via size then arch recombines and reports entry. Identity holds for resident or child; reregistration warns once. Ftrace coincidence gains flag when enabled else rejected. Preamble uses two prefixes; safety needs core or module text, no gate, blacklist, jump, static, bug or preamble veto, module hold and coming check for init. Static decode uses self-relative sums with init bit.

Aggregate disabled only when all children disabled; last-child disable disarms aggregate, restoring on failure. Top removal disables then removes aggregate or detaches child, clearing post handler when no survivor provides it except ftrace marker, with re-optimize when enabled. Gone is terminal. Global disarm blocks arming; global arm clears flag before best-effort per-probe work.

Return admission needs entry, duplicate check, blacklist clearance and bounded data; capacity defaults with floor; storage as rethook or pooled holder. Instances bind to holder and return to owning pool else deferred free. Trampoline resolves frame return, runs handlers with tracking, applies fixup, detaches and recycles. Entry paths count miss when empty and recycle on veto.

Blacklist covers half-open extents; removal deletes starts in range; area walk advances at least one on zero length. Early populate skips invalid, aborts on other errors, covers probe ranges then arch hook. Module arrival adds and departure removes symmetrically. Paging grows array by usage and accumulates length; three builds pair gzip, xz, zstd with decoders; notifier has active and no-op variants at zero.

Uses external generic helpers for container lookup, once warnings, fatal checks, scoped guards, list and hash handling, RCU, per-CPU, object pools, CPU counts, config tests and freeing; behavior defined outside this dossier.

locks.text: Central mutex serializes validation, registration and removal with ownership checks. Blacklist listing holds mutex across sequence; live listing uses RCU with preemption disabled. Text work uses CPU read plus text and jump locks; module scan holds reference; flush uses busy section; removals use RCU with grace before cleanup.

state_machines.text: Breakpoint moves validate, insert, conditionally arm unless globally disarmed, then optimize; removal detaches with grace. Global idempotent flipping flag first. Module phases arrival, reclaim of init, departure retiring init and core; late hook optimizes. Return entry goes acquire, filter and link; miss skips link.
Decompression loops acquire page, decode into it and account bytes until completion or failure; success needs explicit stream-complete; resources released on all paths.

structs.text: Probe holds location or symbol, flags for disabled, entry, ftrace, aggregate, disarm, gone, optimized and trace, miss count, hash and child linkage and handlers. Blacklist holds start, end and RCU state. Notifier uses max priority; trampoline excluded from probing.
Probe listing is bucket-indexed sequence with trivial stop, blacklist a mutex-protected sequence, and global switch a file with read, write and seek.
Enabled content is two-byte text of one or zero plus newline; list and blacklist are read-only, enabled is owner read-write. Debugfs creates directory with live list, switch and blacklist view.
